notes.title: Multiplayer & More Updates
notes.content:
[h1] Multiplayer & More Updates [/h1]
 
Hey everyone! 
 
We've recently released our latest patch that provides updates for the multiplayer side of the game. In addition to fixing all the bugs we could find and reproduce; we have also overhauled the process for starting and playing multiplayer! With a server browser, public lobbies, the ability to continue saved games without all players and being able to convert MP games into single player games, we believe this provides a significant upgrade to the overall multiplayer experience.
Now when creating an online game you no longer are required be steam friends, you simply choose whether you want to host or join a lobby, if you want it to be a public lobby or a private one with a password and then tell your friends to join or wait for new friends!

[b] All players still need to be present in the game when saving during gameplay to remain in the save [/b] It is also recommended you keep in touch with any new friends you make in open lobbies if you want to play multiplayer together again!

We will be monitoring feedback on these changes for both ways to improve them and any reports of bugs or unusual behavior that needs to be looked at.

Other changes since our last Steam announcement include an annual financial statement at the end of the year, new keyboard shortcuts (holding down ctrl when pushing the 'Staff in room' icon will select all room employees), additional filters and other quality of life improvements.

You can find the full list of changes down below.

Thanks to all our players for their continued support, and enjoy!

 

[h1] Full Recent Patch Notes [/h1]
 
BUILD 2024.02.09A --------------------------------

- Multiplayer: A chat is now available in the lobby.
- Multiplayer: You can now continue save games even if not all players are present.
- Multiplayer: You can now load multiplayer save games as a single player (from the lobby). The next time you save, they will automatically become single-player save games.

BUILD 2024.02.08C --------------------------------

- BUG: You could no longer develop spin-offs.
- BUG: No more sounds were played when you loaded a save game.
- BUG (Multiplayer): Duplicate lobbies were displayed in the server browser.
- BUG (Multiplayer): When you loaded a save game, your match was still displayed in the server browser.
- BUG (Multiplayer): When you loaded a save game, sometimes the other players were no longer displayed.

BUILD 2024.02.07A --------------------------------

- MULTIPLAYER: Server browser added. (joining via the friends list is now obsolete)
- MULTIPLAYER: It is no longer necessary to be friends on Steam to play together.
- MOD: You can now set the appearance for legendary staff (DevLegends.txt).
- BUG: Sometimes consoles that will never be released were shown as "announced" when you bought the manufacturer.
- BUG (Multiplayer): When players entered and exited the lobby multiple times, various critical errors could occur.

BUILD 2024.02.01A --------------------------------

- An annual financial statement is now displayed at the end of the year (can be deactivated in the options).
- Menu polishing: Sorting function added.
- Server room options: When you reserve the servers, a check mark icon is now displayed to improve the overview.
- Room options: If you click on the "Staff in room" icon while holding down the "CTRL" key, all staff will be selected.
- MOD: You can now add perks for legendary staff (DevLegends.txt).
- BUG: (AutoBuild function) Sometimes unnecessary objects were placed in WCs.
- BUG: Fixed an bug when loading multiplayer save games.
- BUG: (NpcGames.txt) Sometimes the topic was ignored.
- BUG: If you canceled contract games, you could still be listed as the developer.

BUILD 2024.01.23A --------------------------------

- Sorting function for GameTabs: You can now also display the game list inverted.
- Special marketing: It is no longer possible to publish a demo or send a preview version if there is no platform on the market.
- Own consoles: The number of games in development is now displayed in the console tab and tooltip.
- Own consoles (price settings): The retail price is now displayed.
- BUG: Sorting function for GameTabs was not saved/loaded.
- BUG: (Sandbox) "Work speed of employees" no longer worked.

notes.title: Development Update for 2024
notes.content:
[h1] Development Update for 2024 [/h1]
 
Happy new year everyone! We hope everyone has had a happy and healthy holiday season!
 
Also welcome to all the new players who have joined us lately, thanks for your support and all the reviews!

 We have been busy gathering player feedback and bringing improvements and refinements to Mad Games Tycoon 2 and we're here to highlight some of the most recent changes to the game, with the latest patch coming out today.

 Overall, there have been about 40 changes implemented thanks directly to feedback from the community and we are continuing to update the game, so we're not done yet!
 
[h1] Highlights of recent changes [/h1]
 
The random option for both game reviews and NPC platform popularity has been reworked to give players more options and variation in each new game they start. 
 
For reviews you can now have a random factor of +/- 3%, 6%, 9% or 12% on all your game reviews. This can add a bit more variety to your game reviews, sometimes working in your advantage, sometimes not.

 For platforms, options of +/- 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% (100% will be totally random, as it worked before not a +/- % increase) of the standard NPC platform sales have been added. This will alter the successful platforms you have to release your games on and compete against with your own consoles. Making some platforms more popular, and others less popular every new game.

(Update Jan 18th, 2024 - this has been changed in the latest patch to random platform popularity - low (+/-25%), medium (+/-50%), high (+/-75) and full (this will be the 100% totally random option). This was changed for better user clarity)

 -
 New Sandbox options have been added, bringing the total sandbox choices for the player to nearly 50! With many of these options having further options so that players can fine tune their game to play exactly the way they want.
 
It is now possible to set the working speed of employees in sandbox mode. With this setting you can increase (or decrease) the work speed of employees making them complete task much faster. While this will change the balance of the game, it will also make it possible to have much smaller teams of employees accomplish similar task of large teams. Increase your indie studio feel!
 
You can also change the quality of NPC game releases. This will allow you to play on easy with the NPC releasing top tier games, or on legendary difficulty with competition releasing much worse games and a whole host of options in-between.

 And the option to set the maximum number of staff applications was added as well.
 
These options continue to push forward the ‘freedom of choice’ to play your way we have intended to give players since adding the sandbox mode. We don’t want you to just have unlimited money and call that a sandbox mode. We want you to be able to experiment, play, and even break the balance of the game however you would like. Whether that is the super easy, or the near impossible!
 
-

 Subsidiaries have gotten some attention. We have added 3 additional IP focuses for them, and a few new sorting options to make it easier to tell which are your successful subsidiaries and which are your money pits!
 
-
 
Throughout the game there have been numerous ‘quality of life’ additions, new filters, additional information added to tool tips, search functions, menu and change save states, and more. 

 One of the larger quality of life changes is the ability to specify automatic research across all categories, this was added a few patches ago but now lets the player have much more control over what research they want to automate.

 20 additional save slots were added by request for players who like to have multiple games or multiple saves of the same game going with less limitation.

 And numerous bug, balance fixes and more.
 
As always, you can find a full list of all the recent changes in the patch notes below or the latest up to date patch notes on the steam discussion forum.
 
 [h1] Community Engagement [/h1]
 
As stated above, we still have some upcoming updates and we have a list of feedback already gathered from players we continue to utilize to see what is possible but more feedback is always welcome!

Feel free to participate in our community and let us know what you think!

Perspectives, suggestions, general feedback and the overall support from the community has driven forward the game as it nears the 3rd year anniversary from Early Access in January 21, 2021, to it’s full release in May of last year.

So again, we would like to say thank you to everyone! And lets make 2024 another great year for Mad Games Tycoon 2!

notes.title: Development Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Development Update![/h1]

Hello everyone!

It's been about 3 months since the full release of Mad Games Tycoon 2. In that time, the game has received over 500 reviews on Steam, with the vast majority being positive, and we're very happy with the response and support the game has received from the players! 

Thank you!

We continue to update the game, adding new suggestions, tweaks, and additions to make the game experience that much better! 

Today we are releasing another update, which you can find the details below along with a list of all the changes over the last couple months.

[h1] Suggestions [/h1]

Many of the changes and additions throughout our early access journey came from player feedback and we are still seeking that feedback for things we can improve even after early access has ended.

We've recently opened up a new thread on the Steam discussion forums to collect suggestions to polish the game further, but you're also welcome to post your own threads with your ideas as we continue to monitor for feedback.

And of course, any bugs you may find please let us know so we can fix them ASAP!
 
So join the discussion, make a post, reply here, or leave a review and let us know what you think!


[h1] Full Recent Patch Notes [/h1]

BUILD 2023.08.24A --------------------------------

- (Startup options) You can now set that the suitability of the genres is random.
- (Employee search) You can now set that the employee should not have negative perks.
- (Employee search) You can now select the gender.
- BUG: (Subsidiary menu) Sorting by "Progress" did not work.


BUILD 2023.08.23A --------------------------------

- (Research Room) You can now set automatic research for all categories.
- (Multiplayer) Contract games are now blocked when a player is working on a game concept.
- BUG: (Game Concept) When you closed and reopened the menu, the selected languages were flipped.
- BUG: (Research Room) Sometimes the staff was working when no task was given.


BUILD 2023.08.09A --------------------------------

- The age of the games now also counts when evaluating bundles.
- BALANCE: Sales figures for bundles reduced.
- BUG: (Genres) The platform suitability was reset when loading Save Games.
- BUG: (Options) Sometimes the framerate was set to 30 FPS on restart.
- BUG: (Building Rooms) Sometimes the error message came up that not all rooms are accessible.
- BUG: (Console Development) When a room supports another room, some tasks did not update the percentage bar.
- BUG: Sometimes you could distribute addons by yourself even if you haven't researched production yet.


BUILD 2023.07.27A --------------------------------

- Genres now have a suitability for platform types (e.g. economic simulations sell poorly on an arcade machine).
- BUG: Fixed an error in the calculation of reviews related to obsolete technologies.


BUILD 2023.07.25A --------------------------------

- The "Task completed" icons can now be deactivated in the options.

- MODDING: (NpcIPs.txt) <PLSTATIC> = Sequels have the same platform type of <PLx>.
For example, if you set <PL17> (Personal Computer), all sequels will also be released on the personal computer (if still available) and on consoles. The sequels will then no longer be released randomly on arcade machines or cell phones.

- BUG: NPC studios were sometimes not closed if you did not activate "all" competitors at game start.


BUILD 2023.07.21B --------------------------------

- NPC developers are now closed after historical data (can be disabled in startup options).
- (Game Completed - Screen) An icon is now displayed when a special marketing action is still in progress.
- (Develop console -> Built-in game) Added genre filter function.
- (Stats -> Publisher) It is now possible to sort by subsidiary.
- (Options) Framerate can now be set to 160, 165, 180, 200 and 240.
- BUG: (Own consoles) The bonus for "hit games" was only counted from games with 91% review instead of 90%.
- BUG: (Own consoles) You could choose a freeware game as pre-installed game.
- BUG: (Publishing offers) The tooltip no longer showed the estimated rating.
- BUG: (Publishing Offerings) Sorting by estimated quality did not work.
- BUG: (Multiplayer) It could happen that you could select a subsidiary of a fellow player as publisher.
- BUG: If NPC games you distribute had a hype over 100, the message for overhype was displayed.
- BUG: If you disabled some messages, they were also not displayed in the history.


BUILD 2023.07.13A --------------------------------

- MODDING: (NPC-IPs) You can now force a target platform with "<PLx>".
- MODDING: (NPC-IPs) You can now set the game as exclusive with "<EX>".
- MODDING: (NPC-IPs) You can now set the game as an MMO with "<MMO>".
- MODDING: (NPC-IPs) You can now use "<F2P>" to set the game as F2P.
- BUG: You could not create bundles and addon bundles with 5 stars.
- BUG: Global random factor was no longer rolled at game start.
- BUG: NPCs were mainly using the "Animals" theme.
- BUG: (Multiplayer) NPC game names were not randomized.


BUILD 2023.06.23A --------------------------------

- MODDING: You can now assign Legendary Employees the profession "Game Tester" <Q> and "Office Worker" <O>.
- MODDING: (Genres) If you set "[SUC YEAR]true", successors will display years.
- MODDING: Successors of sports games are now not hardcoded with a year.
- MODDING: (NPC IPs) You can now use "<ROM>" and "<ARA>" to force successors to use Roman or Arabic numerals.
- MODDING: (NPC-Game Names) You can now set the topic "<Tx>" and subtopic "<STx>".
- MODDING: (NPC-Game Names) You can now set the target group "<TGx>".
- MODDING: (NPC-Game Names) You can now force successors to use Roman or Arabic numerals with "<ROM>" and "<ARA>".
- MODDING: Matching genres and age rating of topics, is now loaded from the English file instead of the German one.
- BALANCE: Support calls increased.
- BUG: In the production menu you could enter a negative number.
- BUG: In the developer legends database there were duplicate names.
- BUG: In the database of licenses there were duplicate names.
- BUG: (Console development) The task "Cost optimization" was not saved / loaded in the savegame.


BUILD 2023.06.08A - 2023.06.16B --------------------------------

- Multiplayer: Autosave now works.
- Performance improved.
- Production menu: Buttons for quick input added.
- Options: Auto-save can now be disabled.
- Buying objects: The hotkeys for snapping toggles are now the keys T and G. (to avoid problems with AZERTY keyboards).
- Game Development: When continuing development on a completed game, you can now set how many weeks development should continue.
- Support requests are now linked to difficulty.
- Game tooltips: The name of the IP is now displayed.
- BALANCE: Support requests reduced.
- PERFORMANCE: Gamepass menus should now open faster, and the framerate should now not drop as much.
- BUG: Steam achievements for which you had to have difficulty "Legendary" were also unlocked on low difficulty levels.
- BUG: InputFields no longer worked correctly.
- BUG: Outline shaders fixed.
- BUG: (Gamepass menus) The framerate should now not drop as much.
- BUG: On some PC systems the color scheme was wrong.
- BUG: NPC developers too often chose their main genre for their games.
- BUG: Contract games you didn't accept were released on the wrong platform.
- BUG: (GamePass -> Manage Games) The platform dropdown was not saved.
- BUG: (NPC games) Fixed bug with platform selection.
- BUG: (Multiplayer) When a player left the game, a wrong player could be deleted.
- BUG: (Multiplayer) Profit sharing for own engines did not work correctly.
- BUG: (Multiplayer) Fixed bug when sending IP rating.
- BUG: (Multiplayer) Some data of games was not transferred.

There is a possibility users may experience some bugs introduced from this update, and we are monitoring all feedback to fix any issues that arise ASAP.

The game has been updated to the latest version of the Unity engine. The main reason was the extreme framerate drop when you opened menus, for example, and thousands of games were displayed. Even after you closed the menu, the framerate remained very low.

The changes may have created new bugs, as many functions also had to be completely rewritten or updated. If you notice something, let me know.

notes.content:
[h1]Official Release Day! [/h1]

The day has finally come! After over two years of early access, we are proud to officially release Mad Games Tycoon 2 today! We hope everyone can see all the hard work that has went into the game, and that you enjoy it as much as we have enjoyed developing it!

We would like to again thank everyone for all their support throughout early access. Special thanks to all our translators, modders, guide creators and everyone from the community who have provided us with dozens and dozens of bug reports, balance feedback and other suggestions. And even though early access is ending, our support for Mad Games Tycoon 2 will continue.

While we have never given exact road maps (the pressure involved doesn’t fit our style) we will still be listening to the community for feedback and also will be ready to fix any issues that are reported as well.

We are excited to announce for our Mac players that there will soon be a Mac port of Mad Games Tycoon 2 so that you can officially join in on the fun!

And over the past week we have been working to improve the in-game information with new and improved tool-tips and a revised tutorial that provides a bit more helpful information for new players.

Mad Games Tycoon 2 now supports Steam cloud saves! (For any players who have been in the middle of a multiplayer game prior to this update and find their saves missing -  If you want to use old multiplayer save games, you (and all your teammates) have to rename the save file "mpXXX.txt" to "mpXXX.sav" once.)

We’ve also added a new competition setting for both single player and multiplayer games. At the highest level (Tough) you’ll find you need to play a lot more strategically to avoid oversaturating the market with the same type of games and losing significant amounts of sales (and money). This also can increase the competitiveness of multiplayer, as your friend’s games can now have a greater impact on your releases if you increase this setting.

There has also been improvements to the way publishers handle marketing your games, increases to the cost of marketing your own consoles and a better balance for the support room dealing with tickets from free to play games.

And as always, bug fixes for everything we’ve found reported. The full list will be provided below.
We hope you enjoy the game, have tons of fun and we would love to hear your thoughts – so feel free to leave a review, a comment below or come participate on our Steam discussion forums.

See you in the game!

notes.title: Official Release Date
notes.content:
[h1] Official Release Date [/h1]

Hello again everyone! Getting right to it, we're excited to announce that Mad Games Tycoon 2 will be leaving Early Access May 31st!
There will continue to be updates and support for the game! We do feel Mad Games Tycoon 2 is ready for those players who have been waiting for a more final version of the game. Whether they begin their first long term save, or decide to finally make a purchase of the game - there are many hours of fun to be had and we're excited for anyone who has been waiting to play!
And of course, for all the players who have been playing MGT-2 throughout early access, many of you with hundreds of hours of playtime, thank you for your support! Your suggestions, feedback, and bug reports throughout the last nearly 2 1/2 years have been invaluable in making Mad Games Tycoon 2 the game it has become! So again, thank you!


[h1] Highlights of the Most Recent Changes [/h1]

The last several weeks a lot of work has gone into improving the experience for creating and selling consoles. Some of those changes include -

[B] Console Game Bonus System [/b] Now how many games your console has released for it, and the quality of your games (as well if they are exclusives) has a significant impact on the sales of your console. With a few exclusive 90%+ hit games you can quickly boost your weekly console sales, with the overall potential of your library being able to reach a +300% sales bonus. When you release a console, you'll find all the needed information on the console sidebar tab detailing this system. Having a game pass on your console influences your console sales also.

[B] Console Durability [/b] The quality of your technicians will now affect the durability of your console, additionally you can set the warranty length for your console which will impact both your cost and sales.

[B] Console optimization [/b] You can further optimize your released consoles to decrease their overall production cost and increase their durability. This will allow you to drive down the cost of your pricey new console, with the sale price having a greater influence on how many consoles you sell each week. Hype also has a bigger impact on your console sales.

Some other additions include a market dominance mechanic for custom engines, changes to retro games, several balance improvements and a host of bug fixes. You'll find the full patch notes listing below.

[h1] Your feedback is still needed! [/h1]

We are excited to be reaching the conclusion of our over 2 year Early Access journey but we're not done yet! We still need any and all bug reports you may have, feedback on the game balance and your input on suggestions of what can be improved. While not everything can be implemented, we are always listening and taking into account the feedback we get from our community.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[h1] Development Update [/h1]
Hello everyone! We hope you've been continuing to enjoy playing Mad Games Tycoon 2!

Since our last Steam notification update, there have been tons of changes, tweaks, and improvements to the game. In this post we will highlight some of the most notable changes over the last several months of updates. As always, you'll find the latest and most up to date list of changes on the Steam discussion forum in the patch notes thread and at the end of this post will be a full list of changes.

Also, stay tuned for an announcement soon on Mad Games Tycoon 2 leaving Early Access!

[h1] Highlighting Some of the Changes [/h1]

So over the last couple months some of the most notable changes include -

[B] Create upgraded versions of your existing consoles! [/b] You can develop and release enhanced versions (pro, slim etc) of your current consoles. This allows you to extend the life span of your aging consoles and give them a boost in sales and performance. Many new console cases were also added to enhance this feature.

[B] Copying and pasting of rooms! [/b] You can now copy and paste existing rooms to create multiple rooms of the same type and layout, or rearrange your studio in a snap.

[B] Buying and selling of IPs [/b] If you need some extra cash, or if there is an IP you would really like to own you have the option to buy and sell IPs. This is in addition to the already existing feature allowing you to transfer IPs from subsidiaries you own.

[B] Release your game as Freeware [/b] Releasing your game as freeware can give you a lot of goodwill with fans, increasing their following of your studio and helping future releases sell more.

[B] Game performance improvements [/b]  Significant work has been done improving the game performance, with the game going through multiple performance improvement passes to make for a smoother experience when playing. Additionally, many new options have been added so you can adjust the game performance further.

[B] Multiplayer improvements [/b] The multiplayer lobby has been revised, you can now buy companies in multiplayer, it's possible to sabotage other players, players can go bankrupt and experience negative effects due to bankruptcy. Many bug fixes and other QoL improvements to multiplayer also.

[B] New music and game variety [/b] 10 new soundtracks have been added to the game, 144 new in-game screenshots have been added, 500 new game names and a new system to add more variety to spin-off titles has been implemented as well.

[B] A new map! [/b] The Lagoon City map has been added to the game. This unique map surrounded by water brings the total choice of maps to 6.

[B] Balance improvements [/b]  The game has received balance improvements on all difficulty levels, and many of the game's features have been tweaked and balanced to create a better experience for players.

[B] Bug fixes, Quality of Life improvements and more! [/b]  There have been dozens and dozens of bug fixes, quality of life improvements, new options, adjustments to existing menus and features to make the game more user friendly and enjoyable to play. You'll find the full list below with details of every change in the patch notes.

[h1] Bug Reports & Quality of Life Improvement Request [/h1]
As noted above, we're getting closer to the end of Early Access. [b] Support for the game will NOT be ending at the end of EA, [/b] but right now is an excellent time to report any bugs or unusual behaviors with the game, and any quality of life improvements you may wish to see before release!

So we kindly request if you have any reports or feedback on this, there is an ongoing thread in our Steam discussion forum, you can make your own post or you can reply to this announcement. We will be monitoring feedback to make any necessary changes. We wish to ensure that at full release the game is as optimized and fun to play as possible, thank you!

notes.title: Sandbox mode 2.0 - Play your way!
notes.content:
[h1] Sandbox mode 2.0 - Play your way! [/h1]

It is now easier than ever to get a new game started your way! The new sandbox mode allows you to begin your game development journey as a small startup company, an established industry titan or somewhere in-between!

A lot of work has gone into the new and improved Sandbox mode. You have nearly two dozen options to customize your game, from starting year and funds to boosting how many games or consoles are sold. Choose if your employees get sick, become unmotivated and how fast they learn and what is unlocked for you right from the start! Tailor it to the exact challenge you want, finding the perfect balance for your play style.

New options have and continue to be added to this mode and we're always receptive to additional feedback so let us know what you think!


[h1] Game Pass! [/h1]
Game Pass has been added to the game. Now starting around the year 2004, games you or your subsidiary companies have developed can be added to your game pass. You can setup a server room, name your pass, the monthly fee, select what platforms it's available on and begin building a large library of games through backwards compatibility!

[h1] Progress update! [/h1]

Development is still ongoing! New features and improvements on existing gameplay features and mechanics will continue to be released over the coming weeks.

Currently, a lot of focus is going into improving the performance of the game, it's very important to us that everyone has a smooth, fun experience when playing! Along with this process, a lot of tweaks and quality of life improvements are being added as they are found or suggested.

Console development and mechanics will see improvements.

Multiplayer will also receive future updates improving it's stability, features and adding more options.

And of course, we're always monitoring feedback from players to make additional improvements to the game!

notes.title: Update - BUILD 2022.09.16A
notes.content:
[h1] A summary of recent & latest changes [/h1]

A lot of work has been put into the game since the last Steam notification update! As always, you can find the latest patch notes in the Steam discussion forum. This is the easiest and fastest way to stay up to date with the development of the game.

Here is a summary of some of the key changes with the full notes listed below!

- [b] Sandbox Mode! [/b] -  A much requested feature! It is now possible to start the game in sandbox mode (Selected under 'game modes'), with this game mode you will have unlimited funds and begin the game with just about everything unlocked (that is currently available in your starting year) and ready to develop with! Achievements in this mode are disabled.

- [b] Automatic Room Furnishing and Decorating [/b] - Now when building a room, or remodeling an existing room you have the option to allow the game to automatically place the necessary items, work stations and decorations for that room! This was another highly requested addition that should save players a lot of time when playing.

- [b] A New Genre - Survival Game & 48 New Topics [/b] - You can develop games based on the Survival genre (Available in the mid 1980s) and there are 48 new topics to build your games around! These topics include things like Court Cases, Hotels, Restaurants, Multiple different ancient civilizations and more!

- [b] New Starting Options [/b] - When you start a new game you can now choose between standard development times, or realistic development times. With realistic development times, games will take considerably longer to develop. Additionally, you now have the option to choose any year between 1976 and 2020 to begin your new game!

- [b] 9 New Publishers/Developers [/b] - New Publishers/Developers have been added to the game, along with their IPs. Adding extra competition to the game, and new companies that you can buy and take over!

- [b] Additional Control Over Your Subsidiaries [/b] - You can now see the exact game that your companies have in development, view the full development report of the game and cancel the game they are working on if you decide you want them working on something else.

- [b] MMO & F2P Marketshare Improvements [/b] - The market for both MMOs & F2P is now based on how many players have access to the internet in that given year. You can see this percentage through Market Research and the number will grow as the years advance.

- [b] Overall Game Performance Improvements [/b] - Multiple updates to improve the performance of the game, the pathfinding (more about that below) and make the game more stable as the years go by and your company grows!

- [b] Tons of Quality of Life, Tweaks and Additions to Existing Features, New Items, Balance Changes and A.I Improvements [/b] - You can see the full list below, but many menus have additional filters, easier access and other tweaks. Collision boxes on some items have been improved. New items such as Luxury Toilets and Modern Heating. The development time, game size requirements (A, B, etc) and requirements to get quality reviews have all been better balanced.

The A.I for both employees, and competitors has been improved, with your employees making smarter decisions when fulfilling needs and their pathfinding being improved (Work on this is ongoing). 
Competing NPC companies make additional use of ports (from Arcades -> PC/Consoles), have had their Arcade sales numbers boosted and more.

Employees now request salary improvements through negotiations as they become better skilled.

You have the option to charge for customer support in the Support Room now, there are additional statistics for merchandising in the Fan Shop and many more quality of life improvements, tweaks and much more listed in the patch notes below!

[h1] Upcoming Changes! Development Continues! [/h1] 

And there are still more changes in the works! Console Creation/Development still has improvements and changes coming. Game Pass is still coming to the game. Multiplayer will have performance improvements and additional options/features added plus other unannounced changes and suggestions from the community!

And of course continuing to do more bug fixes, quality of life changes, performance improvements and balance changes to create the most fun and smooth gameplay experience possible!

[B] Thank you for supporting the game! All the reviews, suggestions, bug reports and feedback has continued to push the game to be better and better! [/b]

notes.title: BUILD 2022.05.18A Save Compatibility
notes.content:
[h1] BUILD 2022.05.18A Save Compatibility [/h1]

With the release of BUILD 2022.05.18A, this includes all the changes from the previous opt-in only beta. 


[b] Due to changes in the data structure, all saved games made on BUILD 2022.04.06A or earlier will not work with the latest update. [/b] Any saved games made during the beta should work if you opted into this process over the last few weeks.


[b] We apologize for any inconvenience this causes, but these changes were necessary to improve the game and add additional features going forward [/b]


One of the major changes included in today's patch for anyone not previously playing on the beta is the ability to now transfer your game IPs between the various studios you own. So if another studio has an IP you really want, you can now buy that studio and transfer the IP from them to your studio, or buy a studio and prioritize that they work on an IP you have created and transferred to them!

Thank you to everyone who helped test and report bugs during the opt-in beta process, and we look forward to continuing our work on the game!


[h1] New Map! [/h1]

The latest update also includes a new map! The European Manor! This map has a total of 6 different buildings, all new scenery and different challenges and strategies with the new layout of the map.


[h1] Latest Patch Notes [/h1] 

BUILD 2022.05.18A --------------------------------

INFO:
The beta build has now been converted to a default build. Therefore, old save games are unfortunately unusable. Save games that were created with the beta build should still work.


- A new map has been added.
- Game development: The last engine used is now automatically selected.
- If you win at the Mad Games Awards, you will receive a bonus on sales.
- BUG: Sometimes you could build rooms that blocked other rooms.
- BUG: NPCs gave out more points than allowed in their games in the design focus category.
- BUG: Subsidiaries sometimes developed spinoffs while being forbidden to do so.
- BUG: NPC companies did not develop MMOs until the player unlocked MMOs.
- BUG: "Sandbox Map": You couldn't build rooms before the garage door.
- BUG: You received contract work from subsidiary companies.
- BUG: When you select your own console for a subsidiary to develop for as a priority, that console takes up two slots when the game is released
- BUG: Sometimes your subsidiary stopped releasing players when you put focus on certain IPs.
- BUG: If you assigned four consoles to your subsidiary, it ignored that and chose the player consoles first.
- BUG: If you assigned an engine to your subsidiary, it was incorrectly sold to the subsidiary at cost.
- BUG: Number of awards was displayed incorrectly.
- BUG: If a subsidiary hands you a game to publish on the same week that the Mad Game Awards take place, that game will receive worst game of the year.
- BUG: IP prioritization was not cleared when you swapped an IP.
- BUG: When you created a budget game, the game name was taken with TAGs.
- BUG: If you released a budget game or a GOTY edition of a moved IP, the game was not displayed.


BETA BUILD 2022.04.26A - 2022.04.27A -------------------------------- [b] Included in today's patch for anyone not previously in the beta [/b]

2022.04.26A:
- "Subsidiaries Menu": You can now move IPs to you or subsidiaries.
- NPC Publishers/Developers, Subsidiaries: You can now view their awards.
- You can now get "Golden Records" ect. for contract games.
- "Mad Games Awards": Requirements to win an award have been adjusted. Requirements are now displayed as tooltip in "Mad Games Awards".
- BUG: Bonus sales when an arcade port exists did not apply to NPCs.
- BUG: Arcade machines received the bonus for the Christmas season.
- BUG: Wrong developer was specified for commissioned games.
- BUG: If you had a lot of fans, it could happen that all fans disappeared.
- BUG: In multiplayer NPC games were not sent.

2022.04.26B:
- Place objects: Move camera and deselecting objects with right mouse button should work better now.
- BUG: When you gave a self-made IP to a subsidiary, different bugs occurred.
- BUG: You did not receive fan letters.
- BUG: You could lose publisher relationship with your own company if you used an NPC publisher.

notes.title: Company Acquisitions!
notes.content:
[h1] Company Acquisitions! [/h1]


You can now buy your competitors! This feature was quietly released several weeks ago but has been getting many updates, bug fixes and additions from player suggestions.

Once purchased you have many options to control their decision making process. You can tell them what genres and topics to develop for, what consoles to focus on, whether to develop exclusively for your own consoles, what game engines to use, and how long to spend developing their games. You can also make them prioritize certain IPs, set how much they pay per copy to publish games (or publish their games for them!) and many other choices!

To buy a company you can select from the statistics menu at the bottom of the screen, then select publishers and developers. From here you can select what company you would like to purchase if you have enough funds to do so!


This feature continues to get additional functionality in the on-going beta detailed below.


You'll also find a full list of the most recent changes since the last Steam announcement in the patch notes listed below.


[h1] Development Update! [/h1]

There are a lot of exciting changes on the way to Mad Games Tycoon 2. One of the biggest behind the scene changes has been a restructuring of the way the game handles a lot of the data files. This technical change was necessary to make future changes possible (such as the buying, selling and trading of game IPs between companies).

[b] Because of the size of this change and it changing the structure of many files, this change once it moves out of the beta branch in a few weeks will break save compatability with the previous version of the game. Any saved game made on the 2022.04.06A Build or prior to this build will not be compatible with future updates. [/b]


Currently this change is in an opt-in beta branch only for further testing and feature improvements. Below you can find out instructions on how to participate in this beta if you would like to see the new changes and continue to get future updates before it is officially released.


[b] Once this beta version moves to official release, it will not be possible to play an old saved game made on or before Build 2022.04.06A



We apologize for any inconveniences this may cause with your current saved games, but we also appreciate the understanding that this change was necessary to make Mad Games Tycoon 2 the best it can possibly be going forward! [/b]





As announced previously, there are still changes coming to consoles, the game pass, multiplayer and many other improvements on the way in future updates!



[h1] Opt-In Beta [/h1]

If you would like to participate in the on-going beta you can opt-in and update your game to the latest changes by 


-Right clicking on the game in your Library -> 

-Goto properties ->
-Goto Betas -> 

-And then select the beta test build from the drop down menu.

[b] Understand that there will be some unexpected bugs in this version of the game and your previous saves prior to the beta update will not be playable unless you roll-back to the previous build while it is still available. Once this beta moves to official release, there will no longer be a previous version of the game available to roll-back to. [/b] 

Besides the technical changes some of the current changes in the beta include the ability to trade IPs between your subsidiaries, view subsidiaries award histories, some changes to the way the Mad Games Awards works and additionally all upcoming changes and updates will be exclusively on this beta branch until it goes live.

If you are on the current release build, you will not be seeing many (if any) updates as of late or going forward until the beta version is released. 

[b] A future announcement will accompany the full release of this beta build to let everyone know that a brand new save will be required if it was not made on the beta version [/b]

notes.title: Mad Game Tycoon 2's First Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
[h1] Celebrating One Year of Early Access! [/h1]

In celebration of one year since the beginning of Early Access, Mad Games Tycoon 2 will be on sale this weekend only for 25% off! This limited time offer is the largest discount the game has received, and will likely be the largest discount the game will receive until after release! 

With the game having had over 100 updates since its release last January, this is an excellent time to get involved in the game if you have not yet!

Work continues on the game and there are still many additions and improvements in the process of being implemented, but we believe the game in its current state is a great representation of our vision for the game and the progress it continues to make.


A thank you to everyone who has bought the game, left a review, provided feedback or sent bug reports! Your support has helped the game get this far and continues to push it forward.

And a special thank you to all the game translators for their hard work. Your translation work has helped make the game playable in over 16 languages and allowed many new players to enjoy the game who would not have been able to without your work! 

Thank you!


[h1] A Summary of the Changes, Additions, and Improvements from Throughout the Year [/h1]

Many improvements have been added in comparison to the original Mad Games Tycoon before and after the release of Mad Games Tycoon 2 Early Access - many players who have already played are familiar with these changes already but for anyone new here is a summary of [b] some, not all of the changes [/b] (you can find a full list in the patchnotes thread on the discussion forum)  -

[i] Everything listed below is already present in the game, some things are still undergoing balancing, improvements or have additional changes coming but they are playable now! [/i]

[b] Multiplayer! [/b] It's possible for you and your friends to play together and against each other! You are able to compete for the top spots on all the charts, for employees, contract work and of course compete for Game of the Year awards! You can also share research and financial assistance when you don't feel like crushing the competition! Just start a lobby in game and invite your friends to play! (Additional work is being done on this feature)

[b] Larger and varied maps! [/b] No longer do you have to move (like in the original Mad Games Tycoon) when you've outgrown your studio. The game offers multiple campus style maps where adding an extra building to create your next triple A title is only a click away! There is also a sandbox map, which offers one huge building from the start letting you grow your studio at any pace you wish without having to buy extra space.

[b] A new employee system [/b] You now create your own character at the start of the game with their own traits. Other employees have also special traits (both positive and negative) and a morale system based on how well they feel they're treated. If you give them too much crunch time, not enough breaks, let the studio get too cold or dirty and don't offer them amenities like a lounge they can quit!


[b] Dozens of changes to game development [/b] Honestly too many to list here but I'll try to note some key differences and features in general -

-Games now have an IP rating. - Do you want to build the next great game franchise? Now you can! The IP rating of a game grows as you release better and better games. If you happen to sweep the Year End awards you'll see your game IP get massive gains and become envy of all the competition! All the big IPs compete on a top 100 chart, with the biggest IPs getting boost to their game sales and merchandise sales. There is also an IP menu listing the history of each of your IPs, and all its stats and awards.

- So many game types! - In addition to creating your standard games, you can create sequels, spin-offs of existing games, GOTY editions, budget versions, game bundles, remasters, MMOs, F2P, addons/expansions for games, standalone addons and port your games to Arcade machines or cell phones!

-Arcades! - Participate in the Arcade boom of the 70s and 80s by building a workshop and creating (or porting) Arcade games. Set the price and quality of your machines and watch the orders come in as your technicians try to keep up with demand.

-Individual Platform Market Shares - Do you want to release games for PC gamers only? Is your company exclusively a game developer for consoles? Do you have a game series that you feel should only be on a portable handheld system? This is all possible, as there are multiple platform types with their own market shares and active user bases. 

-Hundreds of genre combinations with their own settings - Every combination of genres is unique, a skill based puzzle game will have different settings than a skill based action game. It's up to you and your studio to figure out the most optimal settings for each through development and quality assurance game reports.

-Specialized fan bases - Is your company known for releasing amazing RPGs? Expect to gain a large fan base of RPG fans who want the next great RPG and might be a bit less interested in buying your new Racing game!

-Platform variations - In addition to the types of platforms having their own market share, every individual PC and console has its own technology level and complexity rating. You need to make sure the game engine you are using to develop your game is not too advanced for the platform you wish to develop on, and if the platform is very complex expect a much longer and buggier development process!

[b] Become your own truly independent studio [/b] 

-Create your own consoles! Create a home or handheld console and compete against other console makers for market share. Try to become the #1 console that everyone must have! (Additional work is being done on this feature)

-Publish your own games, and the games of other companies! Create your production lines, build your storage rooms and become a full-on publisher as you produce your own games and negotiate with other companies to publish their games!

-Build your server rooms to host your MMOs and F2P games. Watch the number of players increase, but be sure to keep the interest in your game high or risk letting all that server space go to waste!

-Deal with support calls from your fans - Keep an eye on your fan meter, your new big hit may be increasing support demands and unhappy fans will forget about your company if they are not addressed!


[b] Progress through the eras and create gaming history! [/b] There are multiple starting dates from 1976 all the way up to 2015 but the game does not end there, you can go much further into the future if you wish! Starting in 1976 you will experience the progress of technology with new tech, items and other advancements becoming available as the years pass. Can you keep up with the progress of innovation, or will your company become a once great memory of a bygone era in gaming history?

-Perform market research - Always be prepared for the upcoming popular trends, know when it is time to shift your focus from one console to another and watch the digital age begin to take hold of game sales!

- Research new technologies as they become available and watch your studio become more experienced in these advancements through development and contract work.

-Sign exclusive contracts with publishers you have built relationships with. Until you are ready to go fully independent and publish your own games, forming these relationships and the financial incentives they provide can be critical to the growth of your company!

-Follow the history through dozens of charts, the history menu, full IP menus that list the entire series history and all of its awards, sales, and revenues, and a historical Year End awards menu that list each year's award winners!

-Random events and random historical events - Whether you have random events on, or decide to go the historical route and deal with events from gaming history, there is always the possibility of an unexpected twist around the corner to deal with!


[b] An ever evolving world of competition [/b] Presently the game contains over 90 competing companies, these companies can release every game type that you can, they utilize IPs and many companies even have exclusive IPs that only they develop! They release new platforms, offer contract work and even try to keep some of their own titles exclusive to their platforms. [i] And in a future not yet released addition, you will be able to buy-out these companies and influence their decisions! [/i]

-New companies through the years - The earlier start date you pick, the more you will see new companies come into the market and begin competing against everyone. You may start with 10 or 20 competitors but by the end be competing against all 90+!

-Tons of A.I and balance improvements - A lot of background work has gone into creating a more active, intelligent and competitive A.I/NPC. These companies will regularly give you a challenge for the top spots on charts and compete for the results of Year End awards on the harder difficulty levels!

-Difficulty levels and speed levels! - From Very easy all the way up to Legendary difficulty, there is a difficulty level for everyone to pick at the start of a game. The higher you go in difficulty you will find the competition steps up their challenge, your sales and reviews will be more difficult and making that first billion dollars won't be so easy! While playing on an easier difficulty allows for a much more casual gameplay experience!

And if you find normal speed too slow, or too fast, you can optionally alter how fast time progresses, giving you more time in each year to develop games, or progressing to the later years much faster! Keep in mind this will impact how difficult the game is.

-Modding capabilities! Many changes are possible with simple text editing ( [b] backup your files! [/b] ) from adding new genres, companies, technologies or platforms there are a lot of possibilities. There is also an active helpful community ready to answer questions and who have created mods, guides and tools to help with this. (Due to frequent updates in early access, mod compatibility is regularly changing so keep this in mind when making changes, keeping backups can help mitigate this)


[b] Dozens and dozens of other changes, additions, and improvements and also more things to come! [/b] As started earlier, We cannot list every change but there have been many, many quality of life improvements, conveniences added, big and small changes to features and a general focus on making gameplay as smooth and fun as possible! 

A lot of work and passion has gone into creating this game and this work and passion continues to go into it!

I hope this list gives you more of an idea what is in Mad Games Tycoon 2 and you decide to join us in this early access journey as we keep working towards full release!

-Additional employee groups can now be created, increasing from the previous 12 max to 25 now. This should allow you enough groups to manage your large number of employees better.

-For balance, NPC console market share now increases faster upon first being released. These consoles should be more useful to develop for in the beginning now and more accurately resemble the initial launch demand consoles go through.

-Companies now have exclusive IPs. This was noted above, but now each company will have exclusive IPs that they focus on. They will work more intelligently to build up these IPs with sequels and spinoffs and create competitive games that will increase their value and place on the charts! There exist over 100 different IPs spanning over the decades that belong to the various companies each with a genre, topic and scheduled time of appearance.

-NPC's exclusive IPs can now be further modded allowing you to add subgenres <SG>, subtopics <ST> and target group <TG>. These extra customization options should allow for much more specialization and variety when adding IPs to NPCs companies.

-11 new companies. These companies and their associated IPs will serve as extra competition in the various genres they specialize in.

-17 new company locations - Many more options to choose where your company is founded.

-25 new Topics/Themes - This will add extra variety when creating games and the Racing genre got some extra attention specifically. The game now contains 255 topics/themes in total.

- It's now possible to click your money listed on the bottom task bar in the game and open up your monthly balance. This provides a much easier and quicker way to keep an eye on your monthly income and expenses!

-Lots of changes to NPCs/A.I - 

The higher the difficulty you play on, the more competitive the NPCs will become with their releases. 

Console developers will try to focus on their own platforms with their releases. 

NPCs will use IPs better and have had some bugs with IP gain fixed, so they now create valuable IPs just like players and the logic behind their development choices has been improved. They also now have a variation in their development speeds depending on the company.

notes.title: Merry Christmas! Happy Holidays! And soon to be Happy New Year!
notes.content:
[h1] Merry Christmas! Happy Holidays! And soon to be Happy New Year! [/h1]

We hope everyone has a safe and wonderful holiday season and to add to the holiday cheer Mad Games Tycoon 2 is participating in the Steam Winter Sale at 20% off!

It is a great time to get the game and join in on the fun! We are closing in on 1 year of Early Access and we're proud of the work done on the game so far but there is still more to come!

You may also notice a certain holiday legend appear in your game as a legendary employee!

[h1] Thanks for all the reviews everyone, you're awesome! [/h1]

A huge thank you to everyone who has left a review of the game, just in the last couple weeks we've garnered nearly 300 new reviews of the game and we're happy to see the vast majority of players are enjoying the game!


[h1] Highlights of recent changes [/h1]


Here are some highlights from recent patches since the last Steam notification update! And at the end of this post will include all the latest patch notes. As always, to find the latest patchnotes check out the Steam discussion forums and the patchnotes thread as not every patch gets a Steam notification update.


- New items have been added to the game! Several new decorations for your studio, a mini golf leisure item and the next levels of production machines as well.

- Contract games have been reworked so that the games offered are now associated with each company offering the contract. These contract games are now a shared pool between all players in multiplayer also.

- The fan shop has been added to the game! Now through the support room you can sell merchandise for your various IPs.

- Significant changes to improve the performance of the game, these changes should be obvious in a lot of menus and also make the late game a much smoother experience

- Historical random events have been added! Can you survive the 1980's gaming crash?

- 12 new company logos and 15 new themes/topics have been added to the game

- Achievements now give different in game bonus'  (You can find these in Management -> Achivements)

- Game ports now have the advantage of being developed faster than standard games. This should increase their value.

- MMOs now have the disadvantage of taking longer to develop. This should help balance their income/expenses more.

- Character Creation: 4 new hairstyles and 2 new beards added.

-New charts! You can now see which games have the highest turnover! Everyone loves more charts!


- Many quality of life changes a few notable ones are : 

When a developer legend appears, his profession is displayed in the message

Now when your employee's max out their skills in the training room you will see a notification above their heads

You can now sort themes/topics by matches and mismatches when developing a game

Hype will now be displayed on minimized game tabs on the sidebar

Player settings are now saved when starting a new game, no more needing to recreate the same character every restart!

You can now change copy protection and anti-cheat software during game development. No more being stuck with old protection right before a new release!

Fan letters now show the genre and can be sorted by genre

In the options you can now set the camera to rotate 90 degrees

You can now change the design priority during development!

The number of exclusive games for each platform is now displayed in the tooltip

Additionally the tooltip for publishers and developers now displays how many games they've published and developed!

On the object purchase menu, Objects can now be shown and hidden by category

Added the search function for the following menus: "Update Engine", "Develop Updates", "Game Concepts", "Game Reports", "Fan Letters", "My IPs"

"Port Game" will not unlock until you have published a game

Sequels and spin-offs can now be developed on other platform types

You can now hide platforms that have a too low tech level for the game you're developing

Addons are now marked with [A] in the game name


Icon for garbage replaced. No more confusing the icon with hunger!


And many more changes! Dozens of bug fixes, balancing to the gameplay and features as well. The full list is below.



[h1] Feature wishlist! [/h1]

Many of the changes in the latest updates came from feedback from the players, and several more things yet to be added were suggested by players as well! 

In the spirit of the holiday season what are some things you would most like to see added to the game? Whether a simple quality of life change, a balance of an existing feature or ideas for upcoming changes post a comment with your wishlist!

On the forums you will find many suggestions that have already been made, community updates with list of suggestions we have reviewed and the ability to communicate with us any concerns/bugs or ideas you have for the game!

No promises that Santa will bring you everything you wish for, but we do appreciate and gather feedback on how to improve the game where possible!



[h1] Latest patchnotes [/h1]

(Build # represents the date the patch was released)


BUILD 2021.12.22 --------------------------------

- Game development: You can now hide platforms that have a too low tech level.
- Game Development: Themes can now be sorted "Matching" and "Mismatching".
- Game porting: MMOs and F2Ps are hidden once they have been ported to computers & mobiles.
- Hype will be displayed for scaled down game tabs.
- Bonus hype for spin-offs is now taken from the latest game of the IP.
- Addons are now marked with [A] in the game name.
- When a staff member has maximized a skill in the training room, a max icon is now displayed above their head.
- Added charts for games with the highest financial turnover.


BUILD 2021.12.15A / BUILD 2021.12.21A -----------------------------------------

- New decoration objects added: 10 pictures, 3 rugs, 3 lamps, 3 plants, 1 table
- New global random event: "Worldwide supply shortages"
- Develop sequels: Added toggle to show only games that have already been taken off the market.
- Buy Objects: Filters are now saved in the save game.
- "Port Game" will not unlock until you have published a game.

- BUG: Some old save games had their sales numbers set to 0.
- BUG: (Character creation) Security function added to restore skill values destroyed by cheats.
- BUG: When closing the filter menu for the games list, the automatic pause was stopped.

BUILD 2021.12.04A / BUILD 2021.12.10A -----------------------------------------

- The number of contract works is now displayed at the room dropdowns.

- Added menu: Stats -> Publishers & Developers -> Publishers
- Added new item: Mini Golf
- Buy objects: Objects can now be shown and hidden by category.
- Added 12 new company logos.

- Publisher & Developer Tooltip: It is now displayed how many games have been distributed / developed.
- Console Development: Added search function for pre-installed game.

- BUG: Sometimes the engine was not set when you developed a contract game.
- BUG: It was possible to use licenses more than once.
- BUG: NPCs did not license engines with level 1.
- BUG: Pathfinding didn't always work when staff wanted to take a break. 
- BUG: Fixed some animations.
- BUG: Release date fixed. (0 weeks and one week had the same effect).
- BUG: Sales prices for bundles were not saved.
- BUG: (Console development) You could select a GOTY game as a pre-installed game.

BUILD 2021.11.28A / BUILD 2021.12.03A -----------------------------------------

- Sequels and spin-offs can now be developed on other platform types.
- You can now change the design priority during development.
- The list of selected employees now adapts to the screen resolution.
- Statistics menu added: Stats -> Info & History -> Profit from merchandise items.
- Game ports now have the advantage of being developed faster than standard games.
- MMOs now have the disadvantage of taking longer to develop.
- "Random events based on history" can now be activated.
- Character graphics: 4 new hairstyles and 2 new beards added.
- In the options you can now set the camera to rotate 90 degrees.
- BALANCE: Fanshop sales penalty reduced (when no game is on the market).
- BUG: Themes of commissioned games were not displayed as appropriate (green) or inappropriate (red).
- BUG: No default price was set for merchandise items.
- BUG: "Automatic selling price" for self-produced games was way too high.
- BUG: (Games) A negative value was displayed for extremely high sales figures.
- BUG: When changing the company logo, the NPC with this logo was disabled.
- BUG: (Multiplayer) When updating an engine, the newly selected special platform was not displayed to the other players.

BUILD 2021.11.27A -----------------------------------------

- Performance significantly improved, as well as the opening of some menus improved (eg the Personal menu).
* Due to the many changes, new bugs may have appeared. Let me know if you notice something.

notes.title: Steam Achievements, Upcoming Features, A Game Giveaway and More!
notes.content:
[h1] Steam Achievements, Upcoming Features, A Game Giveaway and More! [/h1]

It's time for an update! As always, to find the latest and most up to date list of changes for the game check out the Steam Discussion forums and you will find a patchnotes thread that is kept up to date 'Day of' each patch. The game is developing at a quick pace and not every update gets a notification on the steam page!

In this update you will find highlights of recent changes along with full patch notes at the bottom, a look at what is still upcoming for the game, and a chance to get a free copy of Mad Games Tycoon 2!

[h1] Highlights of recent changes [/h1]

In the most recent update for the game, Steam achievements have been added to the game! Additional achievements, some with in-game rewards, along with more achievements for upcoming features will be coming in future updates.

Two new maps have been added to the game! These new maps provide interesting new gameplay challenges, with the sandbox map providing you a massive fully unlocked building from the start to play with!

Tabs and filters for the released game list! A highly requested feature, it is now much easier to manage your list of released games on the right side of the screen with extra options to organize and display the games how you wish.

Several new charts! Now included are weekly charts for mobile, arcade and F2P games, a most popular IPs chart and a new chart for most played F2P games. These help bring more life and competition to the game world as you compete for the top spots.

Many new changes to the A.I competition! NPC games now have IPs associated with them, use license, create spinoffs, ports and GOTY editions. Work continues on this to make your A.I competitors (and later on subsidiaries ) both more challenging and human-like.
 

A lot of 'under the hood' changes - Faster load times for saved games, performance improvements, staff A.I improvements and many bug fixes. This also includes lots of QoL improvements, and general balancing and tightening of the gameplay.


You will find a full list of changes since the last post at the bottom of this update. [b] Again, always remember to check the steam discussion forum for the most up to date list of changes! [/b]. Also post your suggestions and any bugs you may find there as well!


[h1] Upcoming Planned Features [/h1]

While there is not a public roadmap of all the upcoming features and changes, here is a list of a few (not all) of the changes to expect in future updates! Many of these have been first actively discussed on the forums (with some of the ideas coming from there as well), so if you participate on the forums you might know some of these already!

Some of these features are still in the 'planning' stage and will be expanded on later.

Acquisitions of other companies! This feature continues to be worked towards, with many of the listed changes to the NPC A.I being made to ensure that once this feature is added and you purchase a subsidiary that it can do everything you want it to.

Fan merchandise for your games.

A game pass feature.

Expanded console creation options - slim and pro versions of consoles, subscription services (such as the game pass) and other improvements intended to expand on your console choices! Console sales and revenue will also be fine tuned as more options are added.

Additional Multiplayer features. Sabotaging other player's studios, giving support, victory conditions and more.

More revenue options for your support department, allowing you to monetize support calls from fans.

Auto furnishing of rooms! A highly requested QoL feature from MGT-1, this will [b] will [/b] be added once the item list is more completed.

New starting options, challenges, events and more! New things are regularly being added to give players more choices on how they like to play, adding extra difficulty options, new events that can both help and hinder the player and generally just improving the game experience. The late game experience will continue to improve as we get even further into early access also.

And more! The list of additions, changes and the priority of this list is always changing. [b] We want to make the best game we can! [/b]


[b] The game is very much in active development, work is being done on the game regularly and there is no slowdown coming soon with the game expected to be in full development early access for several more months. We hope you are both excited for what's to come, and support and enjoy the game in it's current state also! [/b]


[h1] Mad Games Tycoon 2 Giveaway! [/h1]

If you haven't had a chance to play Mad Games Tycoon 2 yet, or maybe you have a friend who doesn't have the game yet but you would like to play multiplayer together - now is your chance! 

We will be giving away 2 [b] free [/b] copies of the game. All you need to do to participate in the opportunity to get a steam key of Mad Games Tycoon 2 is [b] comment below mentioning your favorite past or present game console to play on (PC, NES, Sega Genesis, PS3 etc) [/b] 


[b] On Friday November 12th, 2021 two people will be selected at random from the comment section and contacted sometime after by community manager Panda with their steam key! [/b]



[h1] Feedback is appreciated! [/h1]

Post a review! Participate in our steam forum and discord (link in the forum). Give us your thoughts on the game, what you enjoy, what you would like to see improved and any bugs or suggestions you may have! We appreciate the feedback and support! [b] The game is in early access but always improving! [/b]


Thank you for your support of Mad Games Tycoon 2! it helps keep pushing us forward!

notes.title: Summer Update!
notes.content:
Summer Update!

With summer coming to a close we wanted to post an update letting players know the changes that have been made in the previous weeks and months.

The game continues to progress, adding more features, gameplay improvements and request from players. We are very happy with the success and support we have received through this Early Access process and we hope you are enjoying the journey as well!

There have been over 24 patches/updates since the last posted notification - these patch notes are regularly posted on the Steam discussion forums with every patch but here are some of the highlighted changes -

- Game design settings (sliders) now factor in both the main genre and the sub-genre. Taking the previous 18 perfect genre settings and now making the combinations nearly 300! This will increase the variety of game designs allowing you to make more unique games and the usefulness of game reports from the Q&A department.

- There are now new events! Your games can become surprise hits, commercial failures or have bugs show up after release. Taking your time to polish your game before releasing it can help you avoid bugs after release!

notes.title: Milestone Update
notes.content:
Console development has been added in the latest update! You can now create and sell your own custom home consoles and handheld systems.

This milestone update follows previous updates that have also added the creation of your own MMOs, Arcade machine games, Free to Play games, and Cell Phone games.

In addition the ability to remaster older games, port games to other platforms, establish long running game IPs with a full history and create spin-offs of existing IPs has all been added since the start of Early Access.

This update represents another major step in Mad Games Tycoon 2's ongoing Early Access journey and we encourage new and existing players to check it out as the game continues to advance forward!

Thanks to everyone for all their support, feedback, bug reports and suggestions!

notes.title: Patchnotes: 2021.01.22C - 2021.01.26B
notes.content:
Patchnotes
BUILD 2021.01.26A/B -----------------------------------------

- The game tabs on the right side of the GUI can now be scrolled.
- Move camera now also works when moving the mouse to the edge of the screen.
- language added.
- Pathfinding improved: employees now prefer objects in their building.
- Russian & Chinese (traditonal) language added.
- Some languages updated.
- BALANCE: Percentage of digital sales increased.
- BUG: "Improve Gameplay" required the skill "Game Design". Now "Game Testing".
- BUG: Games that were on the market for more than 100 weeks were suddenly sold again.
- BUG: When the GUI size was changed, the support room arrow was positioned incorrectly.
- BUG: It was not possible to have two MoCap studios working on two different games.
- BUG: In rare cases there was a crash when loading a savegame.
- BUG: If you had a lot of games on the market, the framerate dropped extremely.

BUILD 2021.01.25A -----------------------------------------

- Multiplayer: Players with IPv6 should now be able to host.
- Depending on the starting year you now get more money and the features are unlocked.
- Hungarian language added
- Chinese language updated.
- BUG: It was possible to build rooms that blocked other rooms.
- BUG: In rare cases, you could not choose a publisher.
- BUG: The "Support room" function could cause a crash.
- BUG: The "Reduce Bugs" event created new bugs.

BUILD 2021.01.24A/B -----------------------------------------

- Singleplayer: The game can now be paused with the Space button.
- Spanish & Brazilian-Portuguese language added.
- Turkish & French language updated.
- When developing a successor, design priorities are now inherited from the predecessor.
- BALANCE: Hype generated by employees reduced.
- BUG: Employees should now not leave the building when taking a normal break.
- BUG: Workload of updates was calculated too high.
- BUG: When creating a remaster, the correct values were not applied in the game concept.
- BUG: When the game was set to Turkish language, you could not research gameplay features.
- BUG: For game concepts, the work priority was displayed incorrectly.
- BUG: In some menus, the release date was displayed incorrectly for games that were not yet finished.
- BUG: You should no longer get the golden record twice for one game.

BUILD 2021.01.23A/B/C -----------------------------------------

- Most menus now have the sort function saved.
- Game Reports menu: "Sort by release date" added.
- You can now see the stats of staff members, even if unpicking is disabled.
- French language added
- Turkish language improved.
- All platform names and dates revised.
- BALANCE: Support (answering emails & calls) should be faster now.
- BALANCE: Event "Global employee dissatisfaction" now doesn't affect as much.
- BUG: It happen that a wrong language is displayed.
- BUG: (Engine menu) "Show only own engines" toggle did not work.
- BUG: Some sounds were not stopped in pause mode.
- BUG: You could not use two graphic studios, sound studios etc.
- BUG: All cleaning robots started to run when there was garbage on the floor.
- BUG: The profession of the own character was not taken over.

BUILD 2021.01.22D -----------------------------------------

- If you cancel a commissioned game, your reputation will now drop.
- BALANCE: The hype gain from the "Mad Games Convention" is now dependent on the difficulty level.
- BUG: Production orders gave you an extreme amount of reputation.
- BUG: Games were wrongly marked as "In Development" in fan letters.
- BUG: You could duplicate your game in the pack menu.
- BUG: If you canceled a production order, your reputation dropped to 0.
- BUG: "Katari 2600" was not released until 1987.
- BUG: "Siga Play Gear" was not removed from the market until 2000.

BUILD 2021.01.22C -----------------------------------------

- Number of characters for game names and engine names increased.
- English & Turkish texts corrected
- BALANCE: Salary for contract games is now tied to the difficulty level.
- BALANCE: Employees should now quit much less often.
- BUG: If a development studio had no staff and you wanted to develop an addon, there was a crash.
- BUG: Licenses could be used infinitely.
- BUG: Employees complained about heat and quality outside of buildings.
- BUG: When supporting a room and moving the task, a crash could occur.
- BUG: You could not pick up employees.
- BUG: Chart position was displayed incorrectly when sorting by user ratings.
- BUG: The game starts with German texts.
- BUG: Crash could occur when starting the game.
- BUG: Game started in 1024x768 resolution.
- BUG: It was not possible to advertise games that were still in development.
- BUG: Fixed some bugs in the tutorial.
- BUG: Some texts were displayed in german.
- BUG: If an employee used an object and you picked up this employee, the object was not reset.
- BALANCE: Effect of training increased.
